stories.title: DPR setujui RUU Ketenagakerjaan sebagai solusi atas aspirasi buruh

en.summary: Indonesia's parliament has officially passed legislation on employment protection in response to labor sector aspirations.

en.title: Government Communications Head: President refers Gibran's diploma case to Constitutional Court
en.summary: The head of Indonesia's government communications agency stated that President Prabowo Subianto has referred a diploma-related legal matter concerning Gibran to the Constitutional Court.

stories.title: Jadi Kepala Bakom, Syahganda Siap Sampaikan Pesan Prabowo ke Rakyat

en.title: As Government Communications Head, Syahganda Ready to Convey Prabowo's Message to Public
en.summary: Syahganda Nainggolan has taken office as head of Indonesia's government communications agency and is prepared to communicate President Prabowo's ideas to the public.

stories.title: Kemensos optimalkan data bansos digital menuju Satu Data Indonesia

en.title: Social Ministry optimizes digital welfare data toward Single Data Indonesia
en.summary: The Ministry of Social Affairs is working to improve integration and updating of data for families receiving social assistance as part of a unified national data initiative.

stories.title: Sambut MotoGP Mandalika 2026, BRI Peduli Latih 500 Relawan Sampah

en.title: Welcoming MotoGP Mandalika 2026, BRI Peduli Trains 500 Waste Management Volunteers
en.summary: BRI Peduli is conducting training for 500 volunteers to manage waste in the Mandalika region ahead of the 2026 MotoGP event. The program integrates education and waste management practices to support creating a cleaner and more sustainable area.

stories.title: PDIP Tegaskan Tak Punya Kepentingan soal Gugatan Ijazah Gibran di MK

en.title: PDIP Asserts It Has No Interest in Gibran's Diploma Lawsuit at Constitutional Court
en.summary: The PDIP party leadership stated the party is not involved and has no interest in the lawsuit challenging educational requirements for Gibran that is being processed at the Constitutional Court.

stories.title: Puan Respons Gugatan Syarat Cawapres Gibran di MK

en.title: Puan Responds to Lawsuit Over Gibran Vice Presidential Candidate Requirements at Constitutional Court
en.summary: House Speaker Puan Maharani stated she respects the legal process regarding the lawsuit on candidacy requirements for Gibran Rakabuming Raka. A Constitutional Court decision is scheduled for tonight.

stories.title: Prabowo Hadiri Penyerahan Uang Rp13,2 Triliun dari Satgas PKH

en.title: Prabowo Attends Handover of 13.2 Trillion Rupiah from Forest Law Enforcement Task Force
en.summary: President Prabowo Subianto attended the transfer of 13.2 trillion rupiah in administrative fines collected from forest law enforcement by the task force.

en.title: Explosion at San Antonio Shopping Street in Surabaya, Dozens of Buildings Damaged
en.summary: An explosion occurred at San Antonio Shopping Street in Pakuwon City, Surabaya, causing damage to dozens of buildings in the surrounding area.

en.summary: Indonesia's coach John Herdman described winning the 2026 FIFA ASEAN Cup as the greatest accomplishment of his football career.
